Role Overview: 
 As our Graphic & Web Designer, you’ll be responsible for designing a wide range of creative assets for ad campaigns, digital products, and web experiences. You must be equally skilled at producing static graphics, motion design, and full website or funnel UI/UX layouts.
 This is a hybrid creative role — ideal for someone who understands both performance creative and digital branding , and can balance fast-paced asset production with thoughtful design strategy.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 ✦ Paid Advertising & Digital Graphics

• Design static graphics for paid ads across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms

• Develop digital product mockups (eBooks, guides, course previews, etc.)

• Create social proof designs, testimonials, headlines, and scroll-stopping carousel creatives

 ✦ Motion Graphics & Video Overlays

• Design dynamic text overlays, animations, and transitions for video ads

• Create short-form motion graphic animations (product intros, ad hooks, explainer-style assets)

• Work with video editors to supply branded elements and motion templates

 ✦ Funnel & Web Design

• Design full funnel and website layouts (landing pages, sales pages, quiz funnels, etc.)

• Collaborate with the dev/ClickFunnels/Webflow/Shopify teams to hand off design files

• Design mobile-first, conversion-optimized pages with clear hierarchy and CTA structure

 ✦ Brand Consistency & Creative Strategy

• Maintain consistent visual identity across client assets while adapting to each brand’s unique style

• Participate in creative brainstorms and pitch visual concepts that align with ad strategy

• Revise and iterate based on performance data and team/client feedback

 Qualifications: 

• 3+ years of design experience across paid media, branding, and web

• Proficiency in tools like Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Canva, and After Effects or similar

• Experience designing for direct-response marketing and understanding what drives conversions

• Comfortable designing both static and animated content

• Strong portfolio showcasing ad creatives, digital product mockups, and responsive web designs

• Bonus: Experience with Webflow, ClickFunnels, or Shopify theme customization

 Bonus Responsibilities (Optional, but Recommended): 

• Template Library Creation : Build reusable templates for ads, social proof, and funnel assets

• Brand Kits : Create style guides and quick-reference brand boards for clients

• Creative Performance Loop : Review top-performing assets and evolve designs based on data
